act: Owen Wassmer's merge of owassmer/CORDON#47 accepts this exact content.
digest_recipe: SHA-256 of sorted repository-relative path + NUL + file SHA-256 + newline, for stage-c .py/.md/.json/.txt excluding __pycache__
scope: The six clocks PR #47 adds take their calendar classes: D.lgs. 42/2004 Art. 146(4)'s five years and following year and Art. 139(1)'s ninety days count calendar time with no roll-forward; Art. 139(5)'s two thirty-day observation terms count as a procedural submission, and Art. 140(1)'s sixty days as an Italian deadline. D.lgs. 19/2021 Art. 33(1)'s reference to L.R. 14/2007 Art. 5(3) binds TREE_LISTED true and TREE_NOT_LISTED false, as its other consumers do. Binding takes effect only on merge.
